course.title: Mechanical Behavior of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: A 4340 steel bar is subjected to a fluctuating axial load that varies from a maximum of (10) 330 kN tension to a minimum of 110 kN compression. The mechanical properties of the steel are: $\sigma _ { \mathrm { u } } = 1 0 9 0$ MPa; σ₀ = 1010 MPa; $\sigma _ { \mathrm { { e } } } = 5 1 0$ MPa (symbols have their usual meaning). Determine the bar diameter to give infinite fatigue life based on a safety factor of 2.50. Assuming the bar has a constant cylindrical cross section of A.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
